text:
Laura: Heads-up — starting a microroute traffic swing in ~30m (23:00 UTC). Plan: canary 5% for 10m, probe p95 and errors, then ramp to 50% if p95 < 120ms and error rate < 0.5%. We'll keep session-affinity pinned. Any objections?
Mike: +1 from infra side. make sure we do a version pin on the model artifacts before ramp.
Sanjay: Question — are we doing cookie stickiness or client-ip affinity? last time cookie worked better for websockets.
Laura: cookie. router config will set cookie-based affinity for microroute.
Anya: If we're pinning model, call out the model hash. Last canary failed due to a stray tokenizer change.
Laura: good catch. pinned model: model-2026-03-15-qa1 (sha256: 9f3b2c). Added to release notes and rollout config.
deploy-bot: scheduled rollout: microroute v2 -> v3 at 3891234567. Canary 5% for 10m, ramp to 50% on success. Healthchecks: /health, p95, errors.
Laura: ops playbook excerpt:
```
# if p95 > 200ms for >2m OR errors >1% for >2m -> rollback
infra rollback --service microroute --to v2 --reason "latency/errors spike"
```
Sanjay: Also warming KV cache before ramp? suggest 5m warm with shadow traffic to avoid cold-cache p95 spikes.
Laura: doing a 5m shadow-warm step, sending 1% sampled traffic with prefer-cache header.
Mike: netops note — I'll watch LB drain times, might extend quiet-window by +2m if we see connection churn.
Anya: added a unit test to catch tokenizer edge-case (PR #4123). Patch merged.
deploy-bot: canary started: 5% -> v3 (task id: deploy-38912-canary). Initial health checks OK.
Ops-Jen: monitoring dashboards green so far. tagging this thread and adding to release log. will post a short post-roll analysis after final ramp. :thumbsup: 
Laura: will hold at 50% for 15m before final flip; manual approve required for 100% cutover. thanks everyone.
